headline: Congress named a post office building in Cotati, California, after Arturo L. Ibleto.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 502 East Cotati Avenue in Cotati, California, as the Arturo L. Ibleto Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or who it serves.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 24, 2022.
